svg.title: GenAI Hub 2.0 — Chatbot Integration Architecture
svg.desc: A transparent architecture diagram with User Touchpoints on the left, GenAI Hub 2.0 in the center, and Connected Systems on the right. The hub contains Chatbot, Agent Platform and KMS / KB in approximately 30, 50 and 20 percent proportions. Agent Integration invokes Chat Agent and receives its AG-UI event stream. Skills retrieve enterprise knowledge. MCP / Connectors integrate with four external systems. Human Handoff connects separately to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Omnichannel.
